questions.question_text: What is the primary purpose of combining visuals and audio in digital storytelling?

options.text: To make the video longer and fill up time
To create a specific mood or emotion and enhance the story’s impact
To confuse viewers with mismatched elements for surprise
To focus only on background music without considering visuals

correct_answer.text: To create a specific mood or emotion and enhance the story’s impact

questions.question_text: How does fast pacing in video storytelling affect the viewer’s experience?

options.text: It slows down the story to build deeper emotional connections
It creates boredom by rushing through important moments
It builds excitement and energy with quick cuts and short clips
It focuses only on long, detailed scenes for clarity

correct_answer.text: It builds excitement and energy with quick cuts and short clips

questions.question_text: Why is creating a series or thematic content important for audience retention on platforms like TikTok or YouTube?

options.text: It confuses viewers by changing topics every video
It gives viewers consistent content to look forward to, building loyalty
It prevents creators from trying new ideas or formats
It focuses only on one-time viral videos without planning

correct_answer.text: It gives viewers consistent content to look forward to, building loyalty

questions.question_text: What is a key benefit of using feedback to improve storytelling techniques in digital content?

options.text: It allows creators to ignore their audience and focus on personal style
It helps identify strengths and weaknesses to make content more engaging
It discourages creators from experimenting with new ideas
It only focuses on negative comments to demotivate creators

correct_answer.text: It helps identify strengths and weaknesses to make content more engaging
